subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 7
body:
Rev 7 fixes R1 F18 / IV-s vpud blocker. Guest fopen() no longer opens any host path: vf_dump_path() returns NULL unless the guest path is under /data or /sdcard, and only then is it rewritten below $N2HW_DUMP_DIR. The guest file system is exactly {registered devices} + {read-only virtual /proc,/sys files} + {the dump tree}. fopen("/proc/self/maps") is now NULL + ENOENT (IV: vpud takes its 0x325c skip branch), and /etc/passwd, /tmp/... and every other host path are unreachable. Device and virtual-file lookups still come first.

Tests: 323 checks (was 309). Added the negative host-path cases with and without the dump dir, the no-host-file-created check, the device-before-rule check, and moved all real-file tests to /data/local/tmp -> $N2HW_DUMP_DIR so the suite does not depend on host access.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (TSan -O1)

The not-done list gains one consequence: there is no host file system beyond the dump tree; if a later milestone needs guest /proc/self/maps content it must be synthesized from the loader-s mapping list, not read from the host. hw-iv and hw-r1 have the details; waiting for their re-run.
